def feats(pts):

 rs-=rs.min(); cs-=cs.min(); h=int(rs.max()+1); w=int(cs.max()+1); n=len(pts)

 y,x=rs/(max(h-1,1)),cs/(max(w-1,1))
 return dict(n=n,h=h,w=w,rp=tuple(rp),cp=tuple(cp),top=int(rp[0]),bot=int(rp[-1]),maxrow=int(np.argmax(rp)),maxcol=int(np.argmax(cp)),
  ybias=round(np.mean(y)-.5,3),xbias=round(np.mean(x)-.5,3),cov=round(np.mean((y-y.mean())*(x-x.mean())),3),
